truncation_clause: Registered text: 'If Faster-GS's DEV-best is its 3M arm, label that scene "ladder may be truncated"'. Applied literally it is a LABEL only; it does not change the class. DEV-best = 3M on 6/6 (3M DEV LPIPS lower than 1M by 0.013-0.054), so all six classes stand (5 FASTER, 1 TIE) and every scene carries the label. Lane matches.

All ratios/holds/caps match lane json exactly: dev-best .573/.560/.404(TIE, hold 1/3)/.487/.404/.512; 1M .884/.944/.653/.792/.596/.865 (lane range .596-.944 correct). Counter TIE is correct: ratio .404 but TEST hold 1/3 (FG-3M test .2158 vs ours-1.2M .2166).

SPLAT_THREAD_CAP=0 (uncapped) and affinity_cpus=6 on all 18. NVML baseline before each arm <=4 MiB. Per-seed ratio spread within scene max 1.08x (truck .495-.533); no outlier under the 1.5x audit criterion of rule:speed-coplacement -> hold may be lifted. Arm train_s spread across seeds max 1.20x (garden ours-300k/500k, room ours-4M) - none in a verdict pair changes a class. Wall ratios (incl. FG preload ~40 s) are lower still: dev-best .34-.48. Runner spans 17:14-18:05Z. Hardware mixed across runners (Xeon 8559C/6962P/one other; driver 610.57.04 / 610.43.02) but within-runner pairing.

recipe.upstream: Partly. Base = the one shipped yaml fastergs_garden.yaml + the code's own 'set to X when using MCMC' annotations (USE_MCMC, densify end 24900, Morton end 25000, opacity/scale reg 0.01, opacity LR 0.05) - confirmed sole config per amendment 476. BUT the MCMC cap is NOT upstream's benchmark recipe: nerficg@e458ac6e scripts/benchmark.py (ENABLE_CUSTOM_MCMC_COUNTS=True) overrides MAX_PRIMITIVES per M360 scene: bicycle 6.13M, garden 5.83M, counter 1.22M, kitchen 1.85M, room 1.59M. The 1M arm is the Trainer.py:32 default only (logged cap_source Trainer.py:32-default; FASTERGS_SCENE unset).
recipe.truck_full: Disclosure present in lane json (label_note 'garden recipe applied (no upstream per-dataset config)') and consistent with amendment 476; truck is not in benchmark.py mcmc_counts either, so 1M default applies there.

discrepancies: WORDING (required): '1M = Faster-GS's shipped default' must be qualified: it is the Trainer default; NeRFICG's own benchmark driver uses per-scene MCMC caps (1.22-6.13M on the 5 M360 scenes). Upstream's benchmark cap for bicycle/garden (~6M) exceeds our 3M rung, so truncation is real there; for counter/kitchen/room the benchmark cap lies between the two rungs.
Ours health minimum is 0.949 (lane initial >=0.96 wrong; corrected 0.95 OK).
